title: Alcohol and Other Drug Recovery & Safe Parenting
description: SS-CURR-004: Supports parents in understanding substance use impacts on children, mapping triggers, building sober care and supervision plans, responding safely to lapse/relapse, and documenting sustained recovery.
outcomes: Understand how alcohol and other drug use affects family routines, emotional availability, and child safety
Build practical trigger maps, craving response plans, and sober supervision arrangements with protective adults
Respond honestly and rapidly to lapses or relapses while maintaining child protection and longitudinal recovery evidence
